title.text: Bitcoin Surges 5% in Broad Market Rally

spans.text: Bitcoin rallied +5.11% over the past 24 hours, reaching $77,598. The surge was accompanied by strong gains across the board, with Ethereum, Solana, and XRP posting gains above 6%.

The recovery gained momentum on Friday (17th), pushing Bitcoin from a low of $73,827 to a high of $77,743 within 24 hours. Trading volume reached $1.76 billion, signaling significant market participation.

On the institutional front, Ethereum ETFs completed six consecutive days of net inflows, reinforcing traditional investors' appetite for the sector. Flow Capital announced the migration of a $150 million credit fund to blockchain through the DigiFT platform — another sign of real adoption from traditional finance.

The combination of consistent ETF inflows and real-world asset migration to blockchain indicates that institutional capital continues to seek exposure to the sector. This is happening even as the Fear & Greed index remains in extreme fear territory, currently at 21 (down from 23 yesterday).

The funding rate has turned slightly positive in recent readings, suggesting long positions are starting to dominate again. Open Interest climbed to $7.48 billion, with new positions being opened alongside the price rally.

If Bitcoin manages to hold above $77,000, the next level to watch is the $79,500 to $80,000 range. Should momentum fade, the nearest support sits around $74,000, close to the closing prices of recent days.

On the regulatory front, the SEC has signaled a softer tone on its new podcast, which could influence sentiment in the coming weeks. Payward's $550 million deal to acquire Bitnomial further reinforces the consolidation of derivatives infrastructure in the United States.
